# Draft:Battle of Dhahban

This battle is documented in the poetry of Prince Omar bin Mutlaq Al-Kathiri in 1223 AH.
Overview
The Battle of Dhahban took place in 1223 AH (1808 AD) in the Dhahban region of Hadramaut. It involved a confrontation between the Al-Kathiri tribes and forces associated with the First Saudi State, led by the commander Ibn Qamla.
Historical Significance
The battle is documented in the epic poetry of Prince and Knight Omar bin Mutlaq Al-Kathiri. The poem describes the resilience of the Al-Kathiri tribes when they united against the invading forces.
One of the most famous lines in the poem refers to the Al-Kathiri forces as "The Sea" (Arabic: البحر), symbolizing their overwhelming numbers and unity at Dhahban.
